title: Book One · Chapter 81: Read the Next Line
story:
Ronan reads the first line on the boat card.

Fold the two sides up.

He folds them up. Then he pushes his chair back and reaches for the basin.

Mei holds the next part of the card in front of him.

“What about this?”

He reads the second line.

Close the corners. Then test the boat in water.

He looks at his paper. There are four small gaps at the corners.

“I knew that.”

“But your corners are still open.”

He sits down again. The new paper is stronger than their first sheet. Miss Wu showed the folds to the class. Her corners were closed, with no holes. Ronan saw her hands fold the paper. But he cannot remember the last fold.

Mei remembers a different fold. They try both on scraps. One makes a high corner. The other leaves a low edge with a gap. They can see the table through it.

Leo passes on his way to his own group.

“Water will come through that big gap.”

Ronan almost tells him to be quiet. Then Leo points to the gap, not to Ronan.

“We made one like that,” he says. “Ours filled with water too.”

Leo walks on. Ronan still wants to ask about their next boat.

Miss Wu is not at her desk. She is outside speaking to a parent. The class still has work to finish. Another teacher is watching the room for her.

Ronan looks at the card again. There are small pictures under the words. His pencil tin covers the pictures.

He moves the tin.

Mei leans over. “That part goes inside.”

They unfold their corner and try the picture's way. The paper makes a tiny crackling sound. Ronan presses it gently. He does not rub hard with his nail.

This corner closes.

They do the other three. Then Ronan reaches for the boat. Mei stops him.

“Last line.”

They read it together. Put the empty boat on the water first.

Ronan has a stone in his hand already. He puts it on the desk. That makes both of them laugh.

The empty boat floats. The sides stay dry. They wait while Mei makes the first mark. No one touches the paper.

When Miss Wu returns, Ronan wants to show her the boat at once. “Please wait,” she says. She closes the door first. Then she finds her book.

He waits. He does not watch the boat every second. When he looks back, it is still floating.

At last she comes over. He shows her the closed corners and the three lines on the card.

“Which part helped most?” she asks.

“The picture I did not look at.”

She smiles. “Everyone needs to see the card. Let us find a place for it.”

The teacher asks them to share the card. Other groups need to borrow it too. Ronan wants to keep it under his tin because it helped him. Mei points at the open shelf. Everyone can see it there. He carries the card to the shelf. He stands it up against a small block. A child from Leo's table comes to read it. Ronan starts to explain, then lets the child finish the three lines first.

At home that evening, Mum asks him to read the sewing note on the table. He reads the first line. Then he looks at the next line too. He gives Mum the collection time. There is another line with the collection time.

Mum checks both. “Yes, tomorrow afternoon.”

Ronan hands the note back. He still reads slowly. But this time he read both lines on the note. He did not stop after the first.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- corner＝角
- gap＝缝隙
- empty boat＝空船
- collection time＝来取衣服的时间

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：crackling＝沙沙声；nail＝指甲。

## 读句提示

**Close the corners. Then test the boat in water.**

封好四角。然后在水里测试小船。原before adding water拆成动作顺序。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan先后忽略了卡片上的哪些内容？
2. 这次经验怎样在家里的小事中再次用上？
